verdict.rationale: Weave documents a dedicated endpoint that ingests OTLP-formatted trace data directly into a project, and an OTel-compatible SDK for instrumenting agents. Traces sent this way appear alongside native Weave data without replacing an existing OTel pipeline. missing for 10: evidence of exporting or receiving traces back out of Weave in OTLP format, transport details (HTTP vs gRPC, semantic-convention mapping), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
